I’ll use the `$i-have-adhd` skill and add this credential-save flow to Clanker: a clear confirmation, a “Return to Slack” button, and an “Open vault” link.

Clanker already saves credentials and resumes the task, but its confirmation has no return button. I’m adding the screen from your example and linking “Return to Slack” to the private conversation for that task.

The confirmation will say “Vault updated,” explain that Clanker will continue automatically, and offer “Return to Slack” plus “Open vault.” I’ll use the same layout after verification-code submission, then check both flows in the browser with dummy data.
